list.summary: A person tips a green wheeled bin onto the pavement, leaving it lying on its side and blocking the walkway.
A person applies spray paint to the side of a stationary train on the platform, creating colorful graffiti, then steps back and walks away.
A silver pickup truck stalls in the middle of the lane with its driver-side door open and a person standing beside it; traffic ahead slows and stops while the truck remains stationary.
A person approaches a locked metal gate at night, uses a tool to cut the padlock, and removes the lock while standing on the pavement.
A white sedan is stopped in the middle of the lane, blocking traffic; vehicles ahead slow and stop while others maneuver around it.
A person walks up to a green wheeled bin on the pavement, opens the lid, and tips the bin over onto its side, blocking the walkway.
